title: Validated plan graph
description: The combined plan of a spec store, output by the plan validator only when every check passes. It is the only form of the plan that leaves the store. Edges name nodes by plan key.

schema_version.description: Version of this format. Readers refuse versions they do not support. Version 2 adds the optional story fields release, review, approved_by, approved_at, and repository.

source_digest.description: sha256 over the plan file and every breakdown file the graph was built from.

parents.description: One edge from each story to its epic.

blocks.description: Blocking edges, between epics (from the plan) and between stories (from the breakdowns).

unplanned_changes.description: Active changes in the store that the plan does not list. They are never synced.

plan_key.description: <change-name> for an epic, <change-name>/<id> for a story.

body.description: Markdown for the tracker issue's description.

approval.description: approved or draft as read from the change's breakdown (a digest mismatch reads as draft); unplanned when the change has no breakdown.

has_spec.description: For a story, whether it covers at least one requirement. For an epic, whether its change has requirements.

depth.description: Column: the length of the longest dependency chain to this node within its view (epics among epics, stories within their epic).

deliverable_kind.description: The breakdown kind of a story; null for an epic.

release.description: Version 2, stories only. True when the story is approved and every story it directly depends on is approved, so a sync releases it to the agents.

review.description: Version 2, stories only. The review gate: human (a person merges the pull request) or criteria (a separate agent checks the acceptance criteria, then Sortie merges).

approved_by.description: Version 2, stories only. The person who approved the story.

approved_at.description: Version 2, stories only. When the story was approved, in RFC 3339.

repository.description: Version 2, stories only, optional. The name of the repository, as the workflow's environment.smolvm.repositories lists it, the story runs in. Absent means the workflow's default repository.
